data.name: ClarifyRedirectUri
data.value: Specify redirect_uri at the time of test.

data.name: ClientType
data.value: Client type to restrict the flow.

data.name: ConfirmNewEmailErrMsg
data.value: The new E-mail address and confirmation E-mail address do not match.

data.name: ConfirmNewPasswordErrMsg
data.value: The new password and confirmation password do not match.

data.name: ConfirmPasswordErrMsg
data.value: The password and confirmation password do not match.

data.name: MaxLengthErrMsg
data.value: The {0} must be at less than or equal to {1} characters long.

data.name: TlsClientAuthSubjectDn
data.value: The DN of the client certificate to use.

data.name: ClientIDDescription
data.value: Identifier of this client. Read-only here; use the button to reissue it. Sent as client_id in requests.

data.name: ClientSecretDescription
data.value: Secret of this client. Read-only here; use the button to reissue it. Used by client_secret_basic / client_secret_post. Not used by public clients.

data.name: ClientModeDescription
data.value: Which route this client takes (normal / fapi1 / fapi2). FAPI tightens the checks - PKCE(S256) and signatures become mandatory. Stored as oauth2_oidc_mode.

data.name: RequirePkceDescription
data.value: Require PKCE for this client. It is OR-ed with the server-wide setting, so clearing it here does not disable PKCE when the server requires it.

data.name: RedirectUriSamlDescription
data.value: Where SAML2 assertions are posted (the ACS URL). The self-test uses redirect_uri_saml.

data.name: RedirectUriCodeDescription
data.value: Where the authorization code is returned. It must match the registered value exactly - not one character may differ.

data.name: RedirectUriTokenDescription
data.value: Where tokens are returned for the implicit / hybrid flows. Put a hyphen when the client does not use them.

data.name: PostLogoutRedirectUriDescription
data.value: Where the RP may be sent back after logout (/end_session). Matched exactly.

data.name: BackChannelLogoutUriDescription
data.value: Where a logout_token is POSTed when the OP session ends. https only (loopback http is allowed). Put a hyphen when the client does not receive it.

data.name: FrontChannelLogoutUriDescription
data.value: Loaded in an iframe when the OP session ends, with iss and sid. https only (loopback http is allowed). Put a hyphen when the client does not receive it.

data.name: SubjectTypesDescription
data.value: What goes into sub. public is the user identifier; pairwise is a per-client value (PPID).

data.name: WebOriginsDescription
data.value: Origins allowed by CORS (web_origins). When empty, they are derived from the redirect_uri. Needed only when a browser calls /token and the like.

data.name: IdTokenSignedResponseAlgDescription
data.value: Signing algorithm of the id_token. When empty, the default is used.

data.name: TokenEndpointAuthSigningAlgDescription
data.value: Signing algorithm accepted when verifying a client_assertion (private_key_jwt). When empty, it is not narrowed.

data.name: RequestObjectSigningAlgDescription
data.value: Signing algorithm accepted when verifying a Request Object (JAR). When empty, it is not narrowed.

data.name: JwkRsaPublickeyDescription
data.value: RSA public key (JWK) used to verify a private_key_jwt or a Request Object.

data.name: TlsClientAuthSubjectDnDescription
data.value: Subject DN of the client certificate matched for mTLS (tls_client_auth).

data.name: ClarifyRedirectUriDescription
data.value: Send redirect_uri explicitly. When cleared, it is omitted - OIDC requires it, so an omission must be rejected.

data.name: ClientTypeDescription
data.value: Which registered test client to use. It decides the route (normal / require_pkce / device / fapi1 / fapi2 / fapi_ciba / the signed-in user). It is not the OAuth 2.0 client type.

data.name: ResponseModeDescription
data.value: How the authorization response is returned (query / fragment / form_post / the JARM variants). Not specifying it leaves the default for the response_type.

data.name: PromptDescription
data.value: Whether the consent screen appears. It applies to every button that goes to the authorization endpoint. none shows no UI - a recorded consent returns a code, otherwise consent_required. Combining none with another value is invalid_request.

data.name: MaxAgeDescription
data.value: Upper bound of the elapsed time since the last authentication, in seconds. When exceeded, re-authentication is required; with prompt=none it becomes login_required. The OIDC button sends max_age=600 unless specified.

data.name: NameIdFormatDescription
data.value: Which NameIDPolicy Format the AuthnRequest asks for. unspecified returns the user name, emailAddress the mail address, persistent a per-RP value (PPID). Not specifying it lets the IdP fall back to unspecified. transient is not supported here.

data.name: ScopesDescription
data.value: Scopes this client may ask for, separated by spaces. When empty, they are not narrowed - only scopes_supported applies.

data.name: GrantTypesDescription
data.value: Grants this client may use, separated by spaces (authorization_code / implicit / password / client_credentials / refresh_token and the urn: ones). When empty, they are not narrowed.

data.name: ResponseTypesDescription
data.value: response_type values this client may use, separated by spaces. Join a combination with a plus sign (code+id_token) because a space is the separator. When empty, they are not narrowed.

data.name: JwksUriDescription
data.value: Where the client publishes its keys. Not used yet - keys are read from the registered JWK columns, and the dynamic client registration rejects this value.

data.name: ClientUriDescription
data.value: Home page of this client. Stored and returned as registered; it does not change any behaviour.

data.name: LogoUriDescription
data.value: Logo of this client. Stored and returned as registered.

data.name: TosUriDescription
data.value: Terms of service of this client. Stored and returned as registered.

data.name: PolicyUriDescription
data.value: Privacy policy of this client. Stored and returned as registered.

data.name: ContactsDescription
data.value: Mail addresses to contact about this client, separated by spaces. Stored and returned as registered.

data.name: SoftwareIdDescription
data.value: Identifier of the software behind this client. It is the same value across every deployment of that software, and is not the client_id.

data.name: SoftwareVersionDescription
data.value: Version of the software behind this client. Stored and returned as registered.

data.name: TokenEndpointAuthMethodDescription
data.value: How this client authenticates itself. When empty, client_secret_basic and client_secret_post are allowed. private_key_jwt and tls_client_auth must be selected here; registering a key or a DN alone is not enough.

data.name: DdlMaxAge600
data.value: 600 (10 minutes. The default of the OIDC buttons)

data.name: DdlNameIdFormatNone
data.value: Not specified (the IdP falls back to unspecified)
